description:
OIDC protocol mapper that reads a `target_realm` form parameter at the token endpoint
        and, when the user holds the `impersonation` client role on `{target_realm}-realm`,
        narrows that role into the access token's `resource_access` claim. Enables a
        master-realm user to impersonate users in any tenant realm without inflating the
        default token with per-client role dumps for every tenant.
